source.title: Kimi Räikkönen — Formula 1 Hall of Fame
source.author: Gerald Donaldson (verify page byline)
source.locator: See precise paragraph or heading locator on each linked claim; unlinked claims remain pending.
source.verification_note: Formula 1 Hall of Fame text inspected on 2026-10-24; unlinked claims still require direct corroboration; no human EN/UK review or independent publisher corroboration.

claims.en: Räikkönen debuted in Formula 1 with Sauber in 2001.
claims.uk: Ряйкконен дебютував у Формулі-1 з Sauber у 2001 році.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Following a rapid series of successes': Sauber signed Räikkönen for 2001.

claims.en: Räikkönen moved from Sauber to McLaren for the 2002 season.
claims.uk: Ряйкконен перейшов із Sauber до McLaren на сезон 2002 року.

evidence.locator: Section 'Raikkonen and his nickname': joined McLaren one year after his 2001 debut season with Sauber.

claims.en: Räikkönen won the 2007 Formula 1 Drivers' World Championship with Ferrari.
claims.uk: Ряйкконен виграв чемпіонат світу Формули-1 серед пілотів 2007 року з Ferrari.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'The phlegmatic Finn delivered sensationally': 2007 Ferrari championship in Brazil.

claims.en: Räikkönen won the 2018 United States Grand Prix for Ferrari.
claims.uk: Ряйкконен переміг на Гран-прі США 2018 року за Ferrari.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Kimi Raikkonen finished a solid third overall in the 2018 Drivers Championship': US GP victory.

gaps: Record precise per-claim source locators and independent corroboration.
Human review of both languages and exact revision required before publication.
